scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev ./dist
scripts.pages:deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy ./dist --project-name=epppe-portfolio
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply epppe-reviews --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply epppe-reviews --remote
